provenance_summary.provenance_notes: In Task 0G.1, exactly 61 tables carried the preliminary Task Intelligence relevance tag (37 core academic/institutional tables and 24 auxiliary LMS tables). In Task 0G.2, 9 additional tables from the 10 Focus Domains and foreign-key dependencies were evaluated (roles, staff_leave_request, staff_leave_details, staff_attendance, staff_attendence_schedules, exam_groups, exam_schedules, students, student_session). The previous prompt's reference to '39 preliminary candidates' derived from the 37 core TI-tagged tables plus 2 focus tables (roles, staff_leave_request). All 70 evaluated tables have verified non-overlapping provenance.

tables.rationale: Classroom assignments. Deferred from initial operational planning.

business_confirmation: EXAM AUTHORITY: Resolve dual exam subsystem coexistence

business_confirmation: PHYSICAL RESOURCE: room_no in exam_schedules is a string label only; lacks room capacity/equipment

business_confirmation: TASK CLASSIFICATION: Confirm pedagogical homework is outside operational WBS scope
tables.rationale: Pedagogical student assignments. Not operational adult tasks. May be referenced later as evidence of instructional workload.

business_confirmation: CURRICULAR GRANULARITY: Clarify whether operational tasks require lesson-level breakdown or macro-subject milestones
tables.rationale: Micro-curricular planning detail. Initial Task Intelligence focuses on macro-WBS and departmental/staff-level work packages rather than lesson-by-lesson pedagogical units.

business_confirmation: SHIFT ENFORCEMENT: Confirm whether staff attendance schedules strictly restrict task execution hours

business_confirmation: QUOTA RELEVANCE: Confirm whether remaining leave quota affects task suitability

business_confirmation: LEAVE APPROVAL STATUS: Confirm status column values ('approved', 'pending', 'rejected') to avoid treating pending requests as definitive absences. No hardcoded status filter (e.g. approved=1) should be assumed without documented evidence.
REMARK/DOCUMENT PRIVACY: employee_remark, admin_remark, document_file contain sensitive medical/personal notes and MUST be forbidden from AI context
tables.rationale: High-value availability source for resource blocker detection (FR-TI-07) and recommendations (FR-TI-09). Deferred until leave status filtering semantics and approval lifecycle are confirmed.

business_confirmation: PROGRESS AUTHORITY: E-7 PostgreSQL is canonical for operational progress; subject_syllabus is read-only pedagogical evidence only
tables.rationale: Syllabus tracking records. Potentially useful later as historical evidence of instructional progress, but deferred until progress tracking integrations are implemented.

business_confirmation: PEDAGOGICAL GRANULARITY: Confirm exclusion from macro-operational engine
tables.rationale: Fine-grained pedagogical detail. Unnecessary for institutional operational task planning and milestone DAGs.

business_confirmation: TEMPLATE BINDING: Used only for validating curriculum applicability

business_confirmation: BELL SCHEDULE: Confirm whether bell timings are operational task boundaries

business_confirmation: HOLIDAY CATEGORIZATION: Confirm which holiday types enforce operational blackout

business_confirmation: RBAC VS CAPABILITY: Confirm that system roles do not define operational task eligibility; professional capabilities reside in staff_designation and qualifications.
tables.rationale: Application authorization roles (Admin, Teacher, Accountant) reflect web interface access privileges, not professional capabilities or task suitability. Downgraded from initial planner context to validation only. Used deterministically by backend services (e.g. event audience filtering) and forbidden from direct task capability inference.

business_confirmation: APPLICATION PERMISSION BOUNDARY: System role mappings are restricted to access control validation.
tables.rationale: Associates staff members with application security roles. Downgraded from initial planner context to validation only. Used deterministically to validate system permissions; does not represent operational task assignments.

business_confirmation: ENROLLMENT STATUS: Confirm whether student_session rows include transferred/inactive students
tables.rationale: Primary table for adapter-derived aggregate cohort count queries grouped by (session_id, class_id, section_id). Result exposed to planner strictly as an integer (e.g. 'Grade 10-A: 38 students').

business_confirmation: STRICT PRIVACY POLICY: Zero student records may be selected or transmitted to LLM. Aggregation only at database adapter boundary.
ACTIVE STUDENT FILTER: Confirm is_active filtering for calculating active student headcounts
tables.rationale: Individual student rows contain 69 columns of minors' personal PII and must NEVER enter planner context. Only used via upstream adapter-derived aggregate cohort count to derive cohort headcounts for exam seating scale.

business_confirmation: FUTURE AVAILABILITY SEMANTICS: Confirm whether historical attendance has any valid predictive role in E-7 planning or if only forward leave requests (staff_leave_request) and timetables govern availability
DATA VOLUME: High-frequency operational punch data creates unnecessary integration overhead if misapplied to macro-planning
tables.rationale: CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL DISTINCTION: Historical daily punch logs CANNOT be assumed to represent future operational availability. Using past punch logs for forward planning without clear business modeling creates significant scheduling failure risks.

unresolved_business_questions.title: Tenant / Organization Scoping
unresolved_business_questions.description: Database iredu lacks tenant_id or branch partitioning. Confirm whether deployment is single-institution dedicated or requires tenant isolation logic.

unresolved_business_questions.title: Active and Soft-Delete Semantics
unresolved_business_questions.description: Tables use inconsistent active fields (is_active int, is_active varchar(100) in events, disable_at dates, status strings). Confirm authoritative active filtering per table.

unresolved_business_questions.title: Examination Subsystem Authority
unresolved_business_questions.description: Schema contains both CBSE examination tables (cbse_exams, cbse_terms) and general/legacy examination tables (exam_groups, exam_schedules). Confirm operational authority for reference use cases.

unresolved_business_questions.title: Physical Academic Resource Source Authority
unresolved_business_questions.description: As established in Task 0G.1A, MySQL iredu lacks room capacity, room equipment, or room master structures (room_no is unconstrained string label). Physical resource authority remains unresolved between Universal and Embedded modes.

unresolved_business_questions.title: Future Staff Availability vs Historical Attendance Semantics
